attributes.title: Reorder grid
attributes.lede: Drag one cover anywhere in the grid.

lesson.concept: Reordering preserves a tile while neighbours move
lesson.why: ReorderGroup owns the ordered values and each item owns a stable value. The grabbed cover stays under the pointer while projection moves the other covers into their new places.
lesson.experiment: Drag diagonally across a row boundary, reverse, and release. Compare Playful pickup and Precise pickup while following one cover's colour.
lesson.pitfall: Index keys make identity follow a position rather than a cover, causing state to jump between items.
lesson.combine: Combine with presence for removal, keeping data identity stable through both reorder and exit.
